function.name: weather_forecast_get_prediction
function.description: Fetches the weather prediction for a specified location and date range, including temperature, precipitation chances, and wind speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographical location for which the weather forecast is requested, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'London, UK'.

start_date.description: The start date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

units.description: The unit system used for the weather forecast results.

include_details.description: A flag indicating whether to include detailed forecast information such as hourly data.

### The “Best” Men’s Underwear Styles – What to Look For Below is a quick‑reference guide to the most common men’s underwear styles, what they’re good for, and why you might choose one over another. Pick the style that matches your body type, lifestyle, and comfort preferences. | Style | Description | Best For | Pros | Cons | |-------|-------------|----------|------|------| | **Boxer Briefs** | Long‑legged briefs that cover the hips and thighs. | Everyday wear, sports, travel. | • Good support, minimal bunching.
• Versatile for all body types. | • Can feel tight if too snug. | | **Briefs (Classic)** | Short‑legged, snug fit with a defined waistband. | Work, casual, gym. | • Excellent support.
• Minimal visible lines under tight clothing. | • May feel restrictive for taller or thicker thighs. | | **Trunks** | Similar to briefs but with a shorter leg length. | Casual, athletic, fashion‑forward. | • Modern look, less bulk.
• Good for low‑cut pants. | • Less coverage for larger thighs. | | **Boxers** | Loose, breathable, long‑legged. | Lounge, sleep, light activity. | • Breathable, airy.
• No compression. | • Can bunch up under tight pants. | | **Boys’ Briefs** | Very short leg, minimal coverage. | Hot climates, very active. | • Minimal material, great airflow. | • Little support, not ideal for heavy activity. | | **Compression Briefs** | Tight‑fit, often made from spandex blends. | Athletic performance, recovery. | • Muscle support, reduces vibration. | • Can feel restrictive if not sized right. | | **Performance/Tech Underwear** | Made from moisture‑wicking, anti‑odor fabrics. | Sports, travel, hot climates. | • Keeps you dry, odor‑free. | • Usually pricier. | | **Lace/Designer Briefs** | Decorative fabrics, often with lace or prints. | Fashion, special occasions. | • Stylish, unique. | • Not always practical for everyday wear. | | **Underwear with a “No‑Line” Waistband** | Flat waistband that doesn’t show under tight pants. | Slim‑fit jeans, tailored trousers. | • Invisible under clothing. | • May feel less supportive. | --- #### How to Choose the Right Style 1. **Body Shape & Comfort** - **Thick thighs / larger hips** → Boxer briefs or trunks for extra coverage. - **Slim build** → Briefs or trunks for a sleek look. - **Tall or long legs** → Boxers or boxer briefs to avoid cutting off the leg. 2. **Activity Level** - **Heavy exercise / running** → Compression briefs or performance underwear. - **Light activity / office** → Classic briefs or trunks. - **Sleep / lounging** → Boxers or loose briefs. 3. **Clothing Compatibility** - **Tight jeans or skinny pants** → No‑line waistband briefs or trunks. - **Loose trousers** → Any style works; choose based on comfort. 4. **Fabric & Features** - **Moisture‑wicking** → Ideal for hot climates or sweaty workouts. - **Soft cotton** → Great for everyday comfort but may wrinkle. - **Spandex blends** → Provide stretch and shape retention. 5. **Budget & Longevity** - **Basic cotton briefs** → Affordable, replaceable. - **Premium performance fabrics** → Higher upfront cost but longer life and better performance. --- #### Quick Recommendations | Situation | Suggested Style | Why | |-----------|-----------------|-----| | **Daily office wear** | Classic briefs or trunks | Minimal lines, good support | | **Gym / running** | Compression briefs or performance briefs | Keeps muscles supported, wicks sweat | | **Travel / long flights** | Boxer briefs or performance briefs | Comfortable, less bulk | | **Hot summer days** | Boys’ briefs or performance briefs | Minimal material, breathable | | **Fashion statement** | Lace or designer briefs | Unique look, great for special occasions | | **Sleeping** | Boxers or loose briefs | Airy, no compression | --- #### Final Tips - **Fit matters more than style** – a poorly fitting pair can ruin comfort regardless of the cut. - **Try before you buy** – if possible, test a few styles in-store or order from a retailer with a good return policy. - **Rotate pairs** – wearing the same pair every day can lead to wear and odor buildup; aim for at least 3–4 pairs in rotation. Happy underwear hunting! If you’d like specific brand recommendations or more details on fabrics, just let me know.
